findings.message: A packet starts or finishes a superframe that does not fit the 256 bytes a decoder keeps of one that goes on in the next packet, or whose spillover bits are not in the packet; FFmpeg's decoder copies none of the bits that do not fit (wmavoice.c), so it reads the cache's old bytes in their place.
